title: Bind independent worker appraisal to the original commission
problem: Mutable evidence can substitute acceptance commands and self-rehash a WorkOrder while the appraiser still accepts its patch.
baseline: #156 at 62d625c: two substituted-acceptance cases return ACCEPTED.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Reuse #157 frozen order and canonical receipt checks in existing workers/appraisal owners.
advantages: No new evaluator, ledger or authority.
disadvantages: Historical standalone appraisals cannot establish canonical binding.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Merge all sibling runtime changes immediately.
advantages: Includes confinement and cognitive evidence adapters.
disadvantages: Broad overlap could regress #156 guards and legacy Cortex contracts.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Independent cross-lineage parity and regression evidence.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Dedicated branch with tamper tests and signed test-key Body missions.
disadvantages: Does not qualify a real frontier provider.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Patch checks can be evaluated against substituted acceptance criteria.
disadvantages: Independent appraisal is not bound to the work authorized.

roles.position: Protect governed self-development before expanding worker selection. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not infer new authority from a stronger proof.

roles.position: Reuse #157 within one existing ledger and appraiser. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not infer new authority from a stronger proof.

roles.position: Challenge local rehashing and canonical receipt substitution. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not infer new authority from a stronger proof.

roles.position: Preserve standalone inspection while disclosing absent binding. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not infer new authority from a stronger proof.

roles.position: Passing patch tests are not approval under the original specification. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not infer new authority from a stronger proof.

evidence.claim: Substituted acceptance is accepted before repair
evidence.finding: Two cases fail the expected rejection, including recomputed local hashes.

counterevidence.claim: Hashing local evidence alone is sufficient
counterevidence.finding: A self-consistent local forgery still needs a canonical receipt binding.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Only the frozen commissioned specification can govern acceptance.

advantages.statement: Existing canonical receipts provide a binding anchor.
advantages.amplified_value: Stronger proof and safer recursive engineering without another authority.

disadvantages.statement: Local hashes can be recomputed after editing acceptance.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Compare the frozen order and artifact metadata to the original canonical commission receipt.

disadvantages.statement: Separate-process reobservation currently omits the journal for worker appraisal.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Pass the existing read-only journal to worker.appraise, retaining all Cortex and pipeline context.

disadvantages.statement: Receipt selection by an edited grant could refer to another commission.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require a unique receipt and compare current mission plus full order digest; refuse missing or ambiguous anchors.

comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Reuse the existing sibling's canonical binding mechanism.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Whole sibling merge adds unnecessary simultaneous migration risk.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Test-key Body replay and hostile local mutations, draft only.

rejected_alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Not needed to close this specific integrity defect.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Cross-contract regression results and material dependency need.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack mutable hashes, foreign receipt reuse, missing anchors, standalone overclaims, compatibility and complexity.

new_weaknesses.statement: An attacker could self-rehash and reuse an unrelated grant.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require unique canonical receipt, original order identity and matching mission.

new_weaknesses.statement: A missing journal could be mistaken for canonical verification.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Return explicit standalone binding limitation; canonical Body/appraiser always supply the journal.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Bound through canonical history and checked by adversarial regression.
Bound through canonical history and checked by adversarial regression.
Bound through canonical history and checked by adversarial regression.

pass_2.final_design: Reuse #157 order/receipt binding in existing owners, preserving all #156 proof, budget, pipeline and isolation boundaries.

residual_risks.mitigation: Explicitly disclose limitation; canonical paths supply read-only journal.

residual_risks.risk: Hostile privileged ledger rewrite is outside this local binding.
residual_risks.mitigation: Retain independent witness and founder-device gates; no invulnerability claim.

dissent.handling: Preserve scope limitations and unfinished full-machine obligations.

entries.position: This repair does not finish Mind-to-Hands selection.
entries.rationale: Necessary appraisal control, not general planning.
entries.evidence_threshold: Dynamic capability selection and original mission resumption.

migration_plan: Selective reuse on dedicated branch; all historical lineages remain.

steps: Revert the binding repair; preserve tests and negative evidence.

kill_criteria: Original legitimate WorkOrders cannot be appraised.
A local forgery is accepted on the canonical path.
Any existing protected boundary is relaxed.
decision_owner: GREG maintainers for development; Alfonso for reserved promotion
